moments.closed: the control step in which the right hand's closure first reaches 1.0 (close phase: set_hand_closure(1.0), then that 20 ms step, the first one with the squeeze rule on); state after the step = its last 1 ms substep
moments.lift: B3's lift frame: first control step of the oracle's 'lift' phase (hand fully closed after the 0.5 s close hold, lift reference just started, palm not yet risen); contacts = data.contact after that step (its last 1 ms substep)

record.normal_force_N: per hand part (thumb = thumb_0/1/2, index = index_0/1, middle = middle_0/1, palm = palm_link; B3's hand_parts), sum of mujoco.mj_contactForce component 0 (normal force in the contact frame) over the contacts in data.contact between that part's collision geoms and any geom of the cup body
record.finger_tau_Nm: the 7 right finger-joint torques applied in the step's last substep (TableScene.last_finger_tau, after the squeeze rule = what was written to qfrc_applied), FINGER_SUFFIXES order
record.saturated: |tau| >= 0.99 x the joint's effort limit {'thumb_0': 2.45, 'thumb_1': 1.4, 'thumb_2': 1.4, 'index_0': 1.4, 'index_1': 1.4, 'middle_0': 1.4, 'middle_1': 1.4} N m
record.touch_N: the right fingertip touch sensors (thumb_2, index_1, middle_1; sim/scene.py: normal force inside a box site around the distal link's collision geometry)
record.timing: data.contact, the contact forces and the touch sensors all come from the last substep's mj_forward (mj_step computes them before it integrates); the torque is the one applied in that substep
